# ARDENNE main-menu artwork

Method: built-in ImageGen tool, new image generation, opaque background.

Project asset: `menu-car.png` in this directory. The standalone HTML embeds the same PNG data and requires no separate image download.

Prompt:

Create a polished widescreen 16:9 photorealistic motorsport game main-menu hero image. An original contemporary single-seat open-wheel formula racing car, carbon black body with vivid acid-lime accents, unbranded with no logos or lettering, parked on a dark charcoal pit-garage floor. Dramatic low three-quarter front view; car occupies the right 65 percent, nose pointing diagonally toward the lower left, all four slick tires and halo visible, accurate plausible formula car anatomy and proportions. Moody large softbox lighting, subtle lime light reflecting on the floor, cinematic premium racing-game art direction, near-black negative space on the left 35 percent for menu buttons. No people, no other cars, no text, no watermarks, no border. This will be an original illustration for the ARDENNE browser racing game's home menu.
